segments.caption: A flash mob performance for the ICC World Twenty20 Bangladesh 2014 begins on a busy street at the Pabna Bus Terminal, where a lone performer in a blue tank top and bright shoes starts by picking up a white ball before beginning his routine, drawing the attention of onlookers and passersby.

A man crouches on a street, preparing to bowl a cricket ball, while a crowd watches from the roadside. The scene then transitions to the official logo for the World Twenty20 Bangladesh 2014, featuring a tiger, marking the event's branding.
